cases.sentence: Господи, услышь молитву мою и внемли моим ___.
cases.explain: The verb внемли (give attention to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Со слугой своим не начинай ___ в суде.
cases.explain: The verb начинай (begin) governs the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Преследует меня ___, жизнь мою придавил к земле.
cases.explain: The noun враг is the subject of the sentence, so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Принуждает меня жить во ___, как давно умерших.
cases.explain: The preposition во (in) governs the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Я простираю руки мои к ___, душа моя жаждет тебя.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Поспеши, ответь мне, Господи, дух мой ___.
cases.explain: In this clause, the subject (дух мой) takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Укажи мне ___, по которому мне идти.
cases.explain: The verb укажи (show) with accusative object means 'indicate' or 'point out.'

cases.sentence: Научи меня исполнять волю твою, потому что ты мой ___.
cases.explain: After the copula мой, Бог is in the nominative predicate complement.

reading.ru: Господи, услышь молитву мою и внемли моим молениям.
reading.question: What is the psalmist's opening petition?
options: That God hear his prayer and listen to his petitions
That God protect him from his enemies
reading.correct: That God hear his prayer and listen to his petitions
reading.explain: The verse opens: Господи, услышь молитву мою и внемли моим молениям (Lord, hear my prayer and listen to my petitions).

reading.ru: Со слугой своим не начинай тяжбы, потому что никто из живущих не оправдается перед тобой.
reading.question: Why does the psalmist ask not to be brought into judgment?
options: Because no one living can be justified before God
Because his enemies are too strong
reading.correct: Because no one living can be justified before God
reading.explain: The reason given is: никто из живущих не оправдается перед тобой (no one living can be justified before You).

reading.ru: Преследует меня враг, жизнь мою придавил к земле.
reading.question: What is the psalmist's condition?
options: An enemy pursues him and has pressed his life to the ground
His enemies have made peace with him
He lives in peace and security
He has defeated all his foes
reading.correct: An enemy pursues him and has pressed his life to the ground
reading.explain: The text states: Преследует меня враг, жизнь мою придавил к земле (An enemy pursues me; he has pressed my life to the ground).

reading.ru: Я пал духом, сердце во мне онемело.
reading.question: Describe the psalmist's emotional state.
options: His spirit is broken and his heart is numb
He is angry and seeking revenge
He is indifferent to his troubles
reading.correct: His spirit is broken and his heart is numb
reading.explain: The verse shows: Я пал духом, сердце во мне онемело (My spirit is broken, and my heart is numb).

reading.ru: Я простираю руки мои к тебе, душа моя жаждет тебя, как высохшая земля.
reading.question: How intensely does the psalmist long for God?
options: Like parched earth thirsts for water
reading.correct: Like parched earth thirsts for water
reading.explain: The comparison is explicit: душа моя жаждет тебя, как высохшая земля (my soul yearns for You like parched earth).

reading.ru: Дай мне утром услышать о Твоей милости, ведь я на Тебя полагаюсь.
reading.question: What does the psalmist ask to hear in the morning?
options: News of God's loving kindness, since he trusts in God
reading.correct: News of God's loving kindness, since he trusts in God
reading.explain: The verse says: Дай мне утром услышать о Твоей милости, ведь я на Тебя полагаюсь (Give me to hear of Your mercy in the morning, for I trust in You).
